title: atlas.claim
description: A single research claim as written into or read from Hypothesis Atlas's research graph — the shape #59/V3.0.6's POST /api/claims endpoint and MCP server accept and return. Published separately from the AGPL-licensed application code (see schemas/LICENSE) so other tools can read/write this shape without inheriting the AGPL.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema the record conforms to.

id.description: Server-assigned id once the claim has been written. Absent on submission.

type.description: What kind of record this claim is.

label.description: The claim text itself, as a short statement.

workspaceId.description: The workspace this claim belongs to. Writes are always confined to the submitting agent's own workspace.

producer.description: Identity of whoever/whatever submitted this claim — a user id, 'research-agent' for an internal run, or an external agent's stated identity (#59).

supersedes.description: Id of an earlier claim this one supersedes, if any (e.g. a replication superseding a prior outcome).

sources.description: Evidence this claim is checked against.

verification.description: Result of running this claim through the verifyClaim() gate (#55/V3.0.2). Null means the claim hasn't been checked.
